::: {.ref-description}
The metrics are comparable to what scanpy.pp.calculate_qc_metrics output,
although they have slightly different names:

Var metrics (name in this component -> name in scanpy):

  - pct_dropout -> pct_dropout_by_{expr_type}
  - num_nonzero_obs -> n_cells_by_{expr_type}
  - obs_mean -> mean_{expr_type}
  - total_counts -> total_{expr_type}

  Obs metrics:
    - num_nonzero_vars -> n_genes_by_{expr_type}
    - pct_{var_qc_metrics} -> pct_{expr_type}_{qc_var}
    - total_counts_{var_qc_metrics} -> total_{expr_type}_{qc_var}
    - pct_of_counts_in_top_{top_n_vars}_vars -> pct_{expr_type}_in_top_{n}_{var_type}
    - total_counts -> total_{expr_type}
:::

### Metrics added to .obs

::::: {.arg-table role="table"}
:::: {.arg-row .arg-head role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="columnheader"}

::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--var_qc_metrics`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Keys to select a boolean (containing only True or False) column from .var.
For each cell, calculate the proportion of total values for genes which are labeled 'True',
compared to the total sum of the values for all genes.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
List of `string`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"ercc,highly_variable,mitochondrial"`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `";"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--var_qc_metrics_fill_na_value`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Fill any 'NA' values found in the columns specified with --var_qc_metrics to 'True' or 'False'.
as False.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--top_n_vars`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Number of top vars to be used to calculate cumulative proportions.
If not specified, proportions are not calculated. `--top_n_vars 20;50` finds
cumulative proportion to the 20th and 50th most expressed vars.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
List of `integer`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `";"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--output_obs_top_n_vars`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Format string for the names of the .obs columns that contain the cumulative
proportion of counts in the top N vars (one column per value in `--top_n_vars`).
Use `{n}` as a placeholder for the top-N value provided in `--top_n_vars`.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"pct_of_counts_in_top_{n}_vars"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--output_obs_num_nonzero_vars`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Name of column in .obs describing, for each observation, the number of stored values
(including explicit zeroes). In other words, the name of the column that counts
for each row the number of columns that contain data.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"num_nonzero_vars"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--output_obs_total_counts_vars`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Name of the column for .obs describing, for each observation (row),
the sum of the stored values in the columns.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"total_counts"`
:::
::::
:::::

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/qc/calculate_qc_metrics/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline/v4.2.0/components/qc/calculate_qc_metrics);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/qc/calculate_qc_metrics/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
